Track both max and min prefix products (negatives flip). O(n).

For max product subarray I will keep cur_max, cur_min and update on each element.

```python
def max_product(nums):
    cur_max = cur_min = best = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        if x < 0: cur_max, cur_min = cur_min, cur_max
        cur_max = max(x, cur_max * x)
        cur_min = min(x, cur_min * x)
        best = max(best, cur_max)
    return best
```
